tickets.summary: Washer does not drain and displays E21
tickets.observed: Cycle stops before spin. Water remains in the drum. E21 appears after the drain phase.
tickets.resolution: With the appliance isolated from power, the technician checked the accessible drain filter and hose for blockage, then ran a supervised drain cycle. The obstruction was removed and the cycle completed.

tickets.summary: Washer fills slowly; inlet error E10
tickets.observed: The inlet phase times out and E10 is displayed. The drum receives little water.
tickets.resolution: The technician verified the supply tap was open and the inlet hose was not kinked, then inspected the inlet screen according to the service procedure. A restricted screen was cleaned and the fill test passed.

tickets.summary: Washer will not spin; load imbalance reported
tickets.observed: The drum tumbles but spin speed is not reached. The display reports an unbalanced load with a single bulky item.
tickets.resolution: The load was redistributed and the supervised spin test was repeated with a balanced load. The unit reached the expected spin stage.

tickets.summary: Washer leaks from the door during wash
tickets.observed: A small amount of water appears at the lower door edge during wash. No leak is seen at the rear hoses.
tickets.resolution: With the unit stopped, the technician inspected the door seal for trapped fabric and visible damage and checked that the door latched evenly. Debris was removed from the seal; the supervised leak test passed.

tickets.summary: Washer vibrates excessively during spin
tickets.observed: The cabinet moves during high-speed spin on a hard floor. No error code is shown.
tickets.resolution: The technician confirmed the transit bolts had been removed, checked that all feet contacted the level floor, and repeated a balanced-load spin test. Vibration was within the service acceptance criteria.

tickets.summary: Washer does not heat water; cycle runs cold
tickets.observed: A warm-cycle test completes but the water remains cold. No heating error is displayed.
tickets.resolution: A qualified technician followed the model-specific service procedure and diagnostic checks for the heating circuit. The temperature sensor connection was reseated with power isolated and the controlled temperature-rise test passed.

tickets.summary: Washer door remains locked after cycle
tickets.observed: The program has ended, but the door-lock indicator remains on and the door does not release.
tickets.resolution: The technician waited for the normal release delay and confirmed the drum was empty and drained. The model-specific door-lock diagnostic procedure identified a sticking latch; the latch assembly was serviced and release was verified.

tickets.summary: Washer makes grinding noise during drain
tickets.observed: A grinding noise occurs only during the drain phase. The filter appears clear and there is no visible external leak.
tickets.resolution: The technician isolated power, checked the accessible filter cavity for foreign objects, and inspected the pump impeller using the approved service procedure. A foreign object was removed and a supervised drain test was quiet.

tickets.summary: Washer displays E20 after rinse
tickets.observed: E20 appears after rinse and water remains in the drum. Drain flow is weaker than normal.
tickets.resolution: The technician checked the drain hose routing for kinks and the accessible filter for lint, following the model service procedure. The restricted hose routing was corrected and the drain test passed.

tickets.summary: Washer detergent drawer retains water
tickets.observed: Water is left in the softener compartment after the wash. The drawer does not overflow.
tickets.resolution: The dispenser drawer and removable siphon insert were cleaned according to the manual and reinstalled. A supervised fill test confirmed water flowed through the compartment.

tickets.summary: Washer does not power on
tickets.observed: The display remains blank and the unit does not respond to the power button. The outlet is reported to work with another device.
tickets.resolution: A qualified technician followed the model-specific power and control diagnostic procedure. With power isolated, a loose internal connection was corrected and the startup test passed.

tickets.summary: Washer overfills during water intake
tickets.observed: Water continues entering beyond the expected fill level and the cycle is stopped for safety.
tickets.resolution: The technician stopped the test, isolated the water supply, and followed the model-specific water-level diagnostic procedure. A restricted pressure-sensing tube was cleared and the controlled fill test passed.

tickets.summary: Excessive suds appear during wash
tickets.observed: Foam is visible in the drum window and the rinse phase takes longer than usual. The selected detergent dose was above the label guidance.
tickets.resolution: The technician ran the model's approved rinse procedure and verified the recommended detergent type and dose with the user. A follow-up cycle completed without excess foam.

tickets.summary: Washer pauses repeatedly during cycle
tickets.observed: The cycle pauses at different stages without a displayed error code. Restarting resumes the cycle temporarily.
tickets.resolution: The technician recorded the pause sequence and checked the model-specific diagnostic history. An intermittent control connection was repaired with power isolated and repeated cycle tests completed.

tickets.summary: Washer drum does not tumble during wash
tickets.observed: Water fills normally but the drum does not turn during the wash phase. No unusual sound is reported.
tickets.resolution: A qualified technician used the model-specific drive-system diagnostic procedure. A loose drive connection was corrected with power isolated and the supervised tumble test passed.

tickets.summary: Washer door will not latch
tickets.observed: The door closes but the program will not start and the door-lock indicator does not illuminate.
tickets.resolution: The technician inspected the door alignment and latch using the service procedure. The latch striker was adjusted and the interlock test passed.

tickets.summary: Washer leaves detergent residue on clothing
tickets.observed: Powder residue remains on dark garments after a normal cycle. The dispenser drawer has visible detergent buildup.
tickets.resolution: The removable drawer parts were cleaned according to the manual and the detergent dose and program selection were checked. A supervised rinse test completed without visible residue.

tickets.summary: Washer has a musty odor after use
tickets.observed: A musty smell is noticed at the door seal after several low-temperature cycles. No water leak is observed.
tickets.resolution: The technician reviewed the model's drum-care instructions, cleaned the visible seal area, and ran the approved maintenance cycle. The odor was no longer present during follow-up.

tickets.summary: Washer takes too long to complete spin
tickets.observed: The spin phase repeatedly slows and extends its remaining time with a small mixed load.
tickets.resolution: The load was redistributed and the technician confirmed the washer was stable and level. The supervised spin test with a balanced load completed within the expected program behavior.

tickets.summary: Water remains in detergent compartment after fill
tickets.observed: The main wash compartment retains water after the fill stage. The softener compartment appears normal.
tickets.resolution: The technician cleaned the removable dispenser insert according to the model manual and checked the accessible inlet channels for residue. A supervised fill test confirmed normal flow through each compartment.
